style.description: Revision of style v1 for FLUX.2 [klein] 4B and Z-Image Turbo, which read whole sentences and ignore negative prompts at CFG 1: the same original dark-fantasy painterly treatment (one bold, centred subject, clear 32 px silhouette, dramatic rim light against a dark smoky vignette, steel and warm firelight) written as prose, with the exclusions (no text, frame, border, people or interface) stated in the positive prompt.
style.prompt: Square fantasy game ability icon painted in a dark, painterly digital oil style with visible brush strokes. One bold subject fills the centre of the square with a strong, simple silhouette that stays readable at a tiny size. Dramatic warm rim light, high contrast, polished steel and firelight tones against a dark smoky vignette background. No text, no letters, no frame, no border, no user interface and no people.

abilities.name: Heroic Strike
abilities.subject: A single longsword swung in a diagonal downward strike, its blade glowing gold with a bright motion streak.
abilities.prompt: A single gleaming longsword slashing diagonally downward from upper right to lower left, its blade glowing with golden light and trailing a bright golden slash streak and flying sparks.

abilities.name: Shield Bash
abilities.subject: A heavy round steel shield thrust forward, its boss meeting a radial burst of impact and sparks.
abilities.prompt: A heavy round steel shield with a riveted central boss, seen from the front, slamming forward into a radial shockwave of impact with cracking orange sparks bursting from its rim.

abilities.name: Rallying Cry
abilities.subject: A curved war horn sounding, with rings of golden sound rippling out and a torn banner behind it.
abilities.prompt: A curved ivory war horn with bronze bands, shown whole and large in the foreground, its bell blasting glowing golden rings of sound outward, with a tattered red war banner behind it.

abilities.name: Cleave
abilities.subject: A broad battle axe swept through a wide horizontal crescent arc that leaves a crimson trail.
abilities.prompt: A huge broad-bladed battle axe sweeping through a wide horizontal crescent arc, leaving a glowing crimson arc trail across the whole image.
